subject: Re: Hosted API sandbox — quick technical briefing for Brightlane
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Coleman <sarah@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API sandbox — quick intro and 15–20m tech window

Hey Sarah — congrats on signing up for the sandbox! I pulled your account and can see some initial calls already. Would you be open to a short 20-minute technical briefing so we can: 

- Walk through the sandbox API key flow and rate limits
- Share a minimal sample prompt that matches your use case (search + generation)
- Confirm any compliance/region needs for Brightlane

Two quick window options today: 11:00am PT or 3:30pm PT. If neither works, tell me a couple times that do and I’ll get Marissa (AE) involved for a short demo.

No heavy prep needed — I’ll send the invite and a one-page preflight doc.

Thanks,
Diego
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Coleman <sarah@brightlane.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom@brightlane.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API sandbox — quick intro and 15–20m tech window

Thanks Diego — appreciate the fast follow-up. 11:00am PT should work for me but Tom (our infra lead) is in meetings until noon. Could we shift to 3:30pm PT? Also quick question: what token throughput should we expect on the sandbox — we want to validate 10 concurrent users with short prompts.

If 3:30 doesn’t work we can do tomorrow morning.

—Sarah
Head of Product, Brightlane
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Coleman <sarah@brightlane.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API sandbox — quick intro and 15–20m tech window

Hi Sarah — Marissa here, thanks for signing up and for the note. 3:30pm PT works on our side; I’ve attached a short preflight (hostedapi-sandbox-setup.md) and dropped a 15-minute invite (15min-technical-brief.ics) — feel free to accept the slot that fits Tom.

Quick answers up front: 
- Sandbox throughput: the hosted sandbox for trials is configured to handle low-concurrency validation. For short prompts (average payload ~300 tokens) you should comfortably hit ~8–12 concurrent inference streams for short bursts. If you want steady-state higher concurrency we can provision a temporary burst pool for the test.
- Rate limits: default sandbox limit is 60 requests/min per account; we can temporarily raise that for the session if you want to hammer concurrency in the live run.

Proposed 15-minute agenda (keeps it tight):
1) 3 min — introductions and success criteria (what Brightlane is validating)
2) 5 min — quick walkthrough: API key, sample calls, logs
3) 5 min — run a live sample and confirm throughput
4) 2 min — next steps & optional Dedicated evaluation

If Tom wants a deeper ops conversation we can extend to 30min — we’ll stay flexible. 

Attachments: hostedapi-sandbox-setup.md (one-pager), calendar invite (ICS).

See you at 3:30pm PT if that works — I’ll update the invite once you accept.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Sarah Coleman <sarah@brightlane.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-15T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API sandbox — quick intro and 15–20m tech window

Perfect — I accepted the 3:30pm PT invite. Tom will join and he asked that you have the sample curl and a short note on token accounting ready. If we confirm throughput we’ll discuss a short pilot.

Thanks — see you later.

Sarah
